_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice, loss partition (lossy): effort outside the known enum values is dropped with a loss report; no reasoning_effort reaches the upstream. Future-expected (source: reasoning.py values-membership drop + lossy apply). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400 vs future 200 with loss header.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_enum_mismatch_lossy
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatlossy]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
compatibility = "lossy"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-lossy"
provider = "chatlossy"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-lossy".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "medium"]
